name: S2 video capture
description: Receive-only capture of the Sparrow2 H.265 liveview over its USB bulk endpoints. Installs one shell helper in /data/local/tmp; the app drives it.
notes: Writes only /data/local/tmp/s2cap. Never starts the radio link, never re-routes the video pipeline, never touches /system or dm-verity. Decoding happens on the PC.
